title: There are words AI couldn't say 🤖

beats.say: There are words AI literally couldn't say.
In 2023, researchers asked GPT-3 to repeat one word. Solid Gold Magikarp.

beats.sub: its reply to another glitch word
beats.say: Another word made it say: You are a banana.
They found three hundred seventy four broken words, out of fifty thousand.

beats.sub: from a group counting to infinity
beats.say: Solid Gold Magikarp was a Reddit username, from a group trying to count to infinity.

beats.sub: one theory: the word list saw it, the model barely did
beats.say: One theory: its word list came from raw internet text. But the model almost never saw those words.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
